title: Order transfer through six for Williamson low-storage Runge–Kutta methods
description: Research candidate proving order transfer through six for the specified Williamson exponential lift and an all-degree repeated-tail tensor identity. A further sufficient order-seven criterion requires three additional tensor equalities; automatic seventh-order transfer is not proved. Includes manuscript and exact-check source. AI-assisted work; external human peer review and proof-assistant formalisation are not claimed.
